entities.summary: Brett Jackson Goode is an American former professional football long snapper. He played college football for the Arkansas Razorbacks and was signed by the Jacksonville Jaguars as an undrafted free agent in 2007. He was also a member of the Green Bay Packers, with whom he won Super Bowl XLV.
